title_card.subtext: Remember death. Then begin your morning.

scenes.narration: How you wake up decides how you live the day.

scenes.subtitle: Every morning, the alarm asks one question.
Recording your answer is the only way to stop it.
scenes.narration: If today were your last day, what would you want to do? Recording your answer is the only way to stop the alarm.
A goal in the morning gives you a meaningful start, and a reason not to snooze.

scenes.subtitle: Your answers become a journal of your life.
scenes.narration: Your answers become a journal of your life. Every night, every week, every month.

scenes.subtitle: Day 7. Seven answers, together for the first time.
scenes.narration: Seven answers, together for the first time.

scenes.subtitle: Share any morning as a quiet card.
A quiet reminder, at the times you choose.
Did you keep this morning's words?
Premium keeps every morning.
scenes.narration: Premium keeps ringing until you answer — so you never miss a morning. And it keeps every morning you have ever answered.
